_comment: Example Claude Desktop config. On Windows this file lives at %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json). Edit the absolute path to ops_mcp_server.py, then fully restart Claude Desktop. `python` must be a Python that has `mcp` installed. `mcp install ops_mcp_server.py` can generate this entry for you.
